question: For each of the four dilutable artefacts (A1, A2, A3, A4), does a same-kind audit statistic stay null at strength 0 and detect the artefact with rising probability as injected strength rises, on data whose ground truth is known by construction?

B1_cleavage.injection: with prob s a true positive is drawn from the near-cut-only subset of detectable Cys; with prob (1-s) drawn uniformly from all detectable Cys
B1_cleavage.statistic: log2 odds ratio of near-cut membership, true positives vs detectable background (positives excluded from the background)

B2_abundance.injection: P(detected | protein i, s) = (1-s)*base_detection_rate + s*(abundance_rank_quantile of i); independent Bernoulli draw per protein
B2_abundance.statistic: rank-based AUC (Mann-Whitney U / (n_detected*n_undetected)) of abundance predicting the detected indicator, over all n_proteins
B2_abundance.cluster_unit: synthetic protein index (one row per protein)
B2_abundance.not_used: a positive-vs-negative abundance contrast -- see LIMIT 3

B3_multicys.injection: for multi-Cys peptides, with prob s the reported site is the Cys nearest the peptide N-terminus instead of the true site (drawn uniformly among the peptide's Cys positions); with prob (1-s) the reported site is the true site; single-Cys peptides are always reported correctly (no ambiguity possible)
B3_multicys.statistic: mean(normalised reported-site position, 0=N-term..1=C-term) for multi-Cys peptides minus the same mean for single-Cys peptides
B3_multicys.cluster_unit: synthetic protein index (peptides mapped uniformly to 300 proteins)

B4_depletion.injection: every truly modified site is always reported; a truly unmodified site is reported with probability (1-s) (independent Bernoulli draw per site)
B4_depletion.statistic: fraction of reported sites that are truly modified
B4_depletion.cluster_unit: synthetic protein index (sites mapped uniformly to 300 proteins)

controls.PC1_null_calibration: sensitivity(strength=0) approximates the nominal false-positive rate of a 95% CI (~0.05); pass rule allows up to 0.10 given Monte Carlo noise at 50 replicates
controls.PC2_seed_reproducibility: re-running the script with the same master seed must reproduce the summary CSV byte for byte; checked by the run script's own re-run, not by this file
